California’s 36th Congressional District is home to many amazing tech companies – including Rainmaker.

It was a pleasure to see firsthand how Rainmaker’s cloud seeding technology helps combat water scarcity in the U.S.

Democrats are working in Congress to support innovative technology and fight for solutions to the climate crisis.

We need to keep human control by ensuring AI systems can be completely shut down if necessary.
